description: Find places in San Francisco or New York ranked by how Asian diners rate them. Each result has the Asian diners' rating, everyone else's rating, the gap between them, how many Asian diners reviewed it, top dishes, neighborhood and a link to its page.

city.description: sf = San Francisco, nyc = New York

cuisine.description: Cuisine or drink category, e.g. "ramen", "sichuan", "korean", "boba", "dim sum".

location.description: Neighborhood or area, e.g. "Mission", "East Village", "Flushing", "Manhattan — Downtown".

near.description: A point to measure distance from; adds distance_mi to results.

query.description: Free text matched against name, cuisine, neighborhood and dishes, e.g. a dish like "soup dumplings".

radius_mi.description: With near: only places within this many miles.

sort.description: asian_rating: Asian diners' rating, highest first; loved_more: Biggest gap above everyone else; most_asian_diners: Most Asian diners; share_asian: Highest share of Asian reviewers; distance: Closest first (needs near). Default asian_rating.

name: search_places
title: Search Asian Recs
